name.text: Q4_Identifying methods that can be used in vital statistics (copy)

questiontext.text:
Indentify a method that can be used to obtain Vital statistics

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

[[ if test="member(1, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is Population registers since they are designed to provide some indication of the possibilities of obtaining statistical information on individuals, households, families, and other units of analysis for potential use in demographic, biologic, medical, sociological and genetic studies.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(2, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is Population census since it is a source for population estimates needed to calculate vital rates based on data derived from civil registration. It is also important in providing the base population for the estimates of statistics obtained from demographic surveys..

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(3, ta_index)" ]]

Sample survey can be used to obtain vital statistics as inferences about the entire population can be obtained from a subset, or sample, of the population members.

[[/ if ]]
